mapper.select: select t.primary_key, t.stock stock, t1.total_inventory total_inventory, t1.shipping_space::BIGINT[] shipping_space, t1.picture::BIGINT[] picture, t2.product_part_sign, t2.primary_key product_part_code, t2.model model, t2.pcs pcs from ${positionStockTableName} t inner join ${inventoryTableName} t1 on t.stock = t1.primary_key inner join ${productPartTableName} t2 on t1.product_part_code = t2.primary_key where t.position_code = #{shippingSpaceId} and t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.delete_flag = false and t1.delete_flag = false and t2.delete_flag = false
